name: Utility vehicles
description: Wheel loader, excavator (ISO joysticks), mobile crane, snow plough and tow truck, a page each. Bind once in the game's controls menu (Bind helper on, so each stick axis is captured on its own). With vJoy, set device 1 to 32 buttons and all 8 axes in Configure vJoy. In BeamNG, use the BeamNG profile's Vehicle page instead: no binding needed.
